about: Every setting an adoption applies, in the order the run applies it: the record of what a new repository, and the organization it belongs to, gets. scripts/setup.py applies those with a report key, in this order, and tests/test_settings_list.py fails when setup.py's SETTINGS and this list disagree, so a setting is added in both places or in neither. scope is what the setting changes, the repository or its organization; app is the App whose token makes the call; permission is that App's permission the call needs; modes are the adoption's kinds that apply it (new is the whole template, existing the protocol alone); when says what else must hold.

settings.value: the board's labels, from LABELS in the template's tools/template_init.py; mode existing leaves out team mode's
settings.when: always; made by .github/workflows/adopt-run.yml, not by scripts/setup.py

settings.value: the template's docs/setup/ruleset-main.json; in mode existing without the rule required_status_checks
settings.when: unless the repository has its own ruleset of that name

settings.value: the repository's topics with symphony added
settings.when: always; the topics it has stay
where the plan and the visibility offer it
an organization's repository whose own setting GitHub refused with 409, where the installation granted the permission; the repository's setting is then tried again

settings.value: the repository added to the selected repositories of the organization secrets the requester owns (SYMPHONY_CLAUDE_1 to SYMPHONY_CLAUDE_32 and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, whose slot's owner in the variable SYMPHONY_CLAUDE_SETTINGS is the requester's login) and of the variables SYMPHONY_CLAUDE_ACCOUNTS and SYMPHONY_CLAUDE_SETTINGS
settings.when: an organization's repository, where the installation granted the permissions; only a secret or variable that exists and whose visibility is selected; no value, visibility or other person's slot is changed

settings.permission: Administration: write (repository), with SymphonyBoard's Checks: read to see the check run
settings.when: on the ruleset this run created, once GitHub Actions has reported the check on symphony/adopt, within ten minutes
